name: pitcode
description: PitCode — a small, friendly programming language with its own syntax.

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.build:web: npm run build && esbuild src/web/browser.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=PitCode --target=es2022 --minify --outfile=dist/web/pitcode.js && node scripts/build-playground.js
